ios.desc:
Need a clean ID / passport photo in a hurry? A quick crop isn’t enough when the size must be right.
ID Photo Generator helps you create properly sized photos from your camera or gallery, then save, share, and export an A4 PDF for printing—all in a few taps.
Standard sizes supported: 30×40mm, 35×45mm (ID/Passport), 51×51mm (US Passport/Visa)
Crisp quality: HD formats up to 600 DPI
Make it look professional: choose background color + outfit style options
Print-ready: generate an A4 PDF with exact mm dimensions
Your gallery, your control: keep generated results organized and ready to share
Create a polished, properly sized photo—right when you need it.
